'''Green''', designated '''CT-53/21-8778''', was a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], one of the many such clones created on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to fight in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. Like Fett, Green was 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall<ref name="Guide" /><ref name="DB Clone troopers" /> and had [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin.<ref name="Skin" /> At the height of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he<ref name="CSWE" /> served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Clone Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in charge of [[Talon Squad]], a nine-man detachment. According to the Grand Army's [[Order of Battle/Legends|order of battle]], Talon Squad fell under the [[2nd Platoon]], [[Bacta Company]], [[Hawkbat Battalion]], [[101st Regiment]], [[7th Legion]], [[327th Star Corps/Legends|327th Star Corps]], [[Second Army|2nd Sector Army]], and [[Systems Army Alpha]].<ref name="Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Green was first mentioned in "[[Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic]]," an article written by [[Karen Traviss]] and [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] and published in the [[Star Wars Insider 84|eighty-fourth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine<ref name="Guide" /> on [[September 26]], [[2005]].<ref name="SW">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20050913.html|text=The Ultimate Clone Guide in ''Star Wars Insider'' #84}}</ref>
